title: Apricot Mustard Lacquered Wings
description: A simmer softens the wings before a short air-fryer finish sets the apricot glaze.
equipment: Ninja Crispi, 4-qt glass container and adapter

ingredients.name: bone-in chicken wing sections
ingredients.note: Weigh with bones. Nutrition assumes about 60% edible meat and skin.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.text: Whisk {broth}, {apricot}, {mustard}, {thyme} into the HexClad. Simmer gently for 2 minutes until combined.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.text: Whisk {starch} with {cold}, then stir into the simmering sauce for 1 minute until it coats a spoon.

steps.title: Steam the wings
steps.text: Steam {wings} on a rack in a covered pot over gently boiling water for 16–23 minutes, until the largest piece reaches 165°F away from bone.

steps.title: Set the glaze
steps.text: Fit the crisper plate in the room-temperature 4-qt glass container. Fit the adapter and PowerPod. Select Air Fry. Brush the steamed wings with a thin layer of sauce and cook 4–8 minutes, turning once, to 175°F. Reserve clean sauce separately.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: For tender bites, pull meat from bones and strip off any tough skin. Toss in the remaining hot sauce just before serving.

notes: Make ahead: prepare the sauce a day ahead and refrigerate separately. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze cooked portions with sauce, cooled within 2 hours, for up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: cover and warm gently with a spoonful of water to 165°F. Freezer reheat: thaw overnight in the fridge, then reheat covered to 165°F. Option A uses the listed seasonings. For gentler Option B, omit added citrus, vinegar or chile where used. Pass additional heat at the table. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 275 kcal, 22.4 g protein, 16.6 g total carbohydrate, 13.5 g fat, 0.4 g fiber, 118 mg sodium.
